DC Super-Villains Swing™

Unleash Your Inner Hero & Take on the DC Super-Villains Swing™. The world’s most notorious villains have teamed up to deliver a thrilling sky-high amusement park swing ride that’ll lift your chair right off the ground. Are you bold enough to face them? Take a seat in one of the swing chairs circling the colorful central tower, which is decked out with portraits of THE PENGUIN, POISON IVY, THE JOKER and even MR. FREEZE! There’s no running from them this time, you’ll have to face your fate. You’ll slowly lift off the ground, higher and higher at the mercy of these relentless villains. Then, as you spin faster, they’ll add a tilt just to scare you even more. Looks like THE JOKER got the last laugh this time!

Giant Drop

The Drop Tower That Pushes Limits Strap into your chair and settle in, because the ride up the 227-foot tower will be the longest, most adrenaline-charged few seconds of your life. As you’re being lifted 20 stories in the air, feet dangling helplessly above the tiny people below, fear and anticipation take over every rational thought. But don’t get too comfortable, because it’s time for this drop tower ride to do what drop towers do best. Suddenly your seat will release and you’ll plunge straight down to the earth at a screaming 62 mph — so fast you’ll barely have time to scream. But you will. Are you brave enough to ride the 227-foot giant that takes drop towers to new heights?

Sky Striker

Gravity-Defying Freefall Experience Buckle up for a towering, twisting, totally thrilling adventure into the physics of fun! If screaming through the sky at speeds up to 75 mph on a twisting platform of physics-defying fun is your jam, you’ve come to the right thrill ride. Sky Striker is the ultimate high-flying, stomach-dropping adventure you’ll want to experience again and again. Hold on tight as you teeter on the edge of upside-down feeling the insane rush of a 17-story drop before rocketing back up for another heart-pounding swing as you zoom across the midway and do it all over again. As if defying gravity wasn’t enough, there’s another twist to this ride. Sky Striker spins with every swing, amping up the G-forces for a truly unforgettable thrill. Thrillseekers will love this one-of-a-kind pendulum ride that delivers endless freefall sensation on repeat — and cranks the volume up to 11! There’s no better way to take in Six Flags Great America than soaring along 130-degree arcs on the incomparable Sky Striker pendulum thrill ride!

Located 984 feet from Times Square in New York, LUMA Hotel - Times Square features a restaurant and free WiFi throughout the property. Guests can enjoy the on-site bar.

Every room at this hotel is air conditioned and is equipped with a 50 inch flat-screen TV with cable channels and windows with electronic control sheer and blackout shades. King rooms feature a sofa area where you can relax. You will find a Nespresso coffee machine in the room. Rooms are fitted with a private bathroom. For your comfort, you will find  Frette Linens and bathrobes, slippers and CO BIGELOW BATH amenities.

There is a 24-hour front desk at the property.

AperiBar, join us for our daily continental breakfast, dinner or drinks. The perfect location to linger over dinner with antipasti, oysters + crudo of the day, salads, pizza, pasta as well as some of our favorites from land and sea with an unforgettable setting to experience carefully curated menus by Charlie Palmer.

The hotel also offers car hire. Macy's is 1640 feet from LUMA Hotel - Times Square, while Empire State Building is 2297 feet from the property. The nearest airport is LaGuardia Airport, 6.2 mi from the property.

Couples in particular like the location – they rated it 9.8 for a two-person trip.

8 Quotes from President Dina Boluarte of Peru at the APEC CEO Summit
Lima, Peru | 14 November 2024

President Dina Boluarte delivered remarks during the 2024 APEC CEO Summit. She spoke about Peru’s experiences, commitment and opportunities in driving an inclusive, sustainable and resilient growth.

On hosting APEC
1. "We took up the challenge of being the host of APEC for the third time [in order] to reinforce integration and its benefits for people who are always putting value on their needs and aspirations."

On shared vision
2. "We have a shared vision of an inclusive, sustainable and resilient growth."

3. "Peru has implemented dialogues and actions that reflect our commitment, which reflects the APEC Putrajaya Vision 2040."

On Peru’s experiences, commitment and opportunities
4. "Peru is firm in its path of economic reactivation, with an expansion of GDP by more than 3 percent in 2024, the generation of jobs and being at a very important role around the world, and taking the most of its strategic position in the continent to develop its capabilities, build well-being and security."

5. "Peru opens its doors and gives the warmest welcome to investment funds and capital from all around the world by offering foreign investors legal stability, economic stability, and clear rules of the game that will guarantee sustainable growth."

6. "We keep our monetary and fiscal strength and sound international reserves and inflation, which is among the lowest in Latin America, and we have presence in world markets as well."

7. "Peru is full of investment opportunities in different sectors, from infrastructure, mining, technology, renewable energy and tourism."

8. "We promote the unlocking of crucial projects that will show a ‘before and after’ in our economy."
